_about: City data for location pages. Only Bengaluru has our studio (in_person: true). Every other city is served remotely, with travel for shoots when a project needs it. Never add an address for a city where we have no office.

bangalore.name: Bangalore
bangalore.areas: Indiranagar, Koramangala, HSR Layout, Whitefield, Jayanagar, Malleswaram and the wholesale lanes of Chickpet and Avenue Road
bangalore.intro: Bengaluru is where our studio is, in Shantinagar. The city runs on startups and SaaS companies, but its older trades (silk, gold, paper and wholesale) need standout content just as much. Mahaveer Papers, whose Instagram and AI chatbot we run, is one of them.
bangalore.jewellery_note: Bengaluru buyers shop jewellery from Jayanagar and Malleswaram to Commercial Street, and Varamahalakshmi, Dasara and wedding season are the big buying windows.

mumbai.name: Mumbai
mumbai.areas: Lower Parel, Andheri, BKC, Powai, Kalbadevi and Zaveri Bazaar
mumbai.intro: Mumbai brands compete in the most crowded feed in India, next to media houses and finance brands with large budgets. AI production lets a Mumbai brand ship campaign-quality films and reels at a fraction of a full shoot.
mumbai.jewellery_note: Mumbai's jewellery trade runs from Zaveri Bazaar to the diamond houses around BKC, and Dhanteras, Diwali and wedding season decide the year.

delhi-ncr.name: Delhi NCR
delhi-ncr.areas: Gurugram's Cyber City, Noida, Connaught Place, South Delhi, Karol Bagh and Chandni Chowk
delhi-ncr.intro: Delhi NCR mixes corporate Gurugram, Noida's tech parks and some of India's oldest bazaars. Buyers here compare a lot before they decide, so clear video and fast replies win the enquiry.
delhi-ncr.jewellery_note: Delhi buys jewellery from Karol Bagh, South Delhi showrooms and the old lanes of Dariba Kalan in Chandni Chowk, with wedding season from November to February as the peak.

hyderabad.name: Hyderabad
hyderabad.areas: HITEC City, Gachibowli, Banjara Hills, Jubilee Hills and the old city around Charminar
hyderabad.intro: Hyderabad's growth runs on IT, pharma and real estate, and its old city still sets the standard for pearls and bangles. Telugu and English content side by side reaches both markets.
hyderabad.jewellery_note: Hyderabad is known for its pearls and for the bangle lanes of Laad Bazaar near Charminar, alongside large showrooms in Banjara Hills and Jubilee Hills.

chennai.name: Chennai
chennai.areas: T. Nagar, OMR, Guindy, Anna Nagar, Nungambakkam and Mylapore
chennai.intro: Chennai is home to many of India's SaaS companies, a large automotive belt and some of the busiest jewellery and silk streets in the country. Tamil-first content performs strongly here.
chennai.jewellery_note: Chennai's jewellery and silk trade centres on T. Nagar, and Akshaya Tritiya is one of the biggest gold-buying days of the year in Tamil Nadu.

pune.name: Pune
pune.areas: Hinjewadi, Kharadi, Baner, Koregaon Park, Kothrud and Viman Nagar
pune.intro: Pune combines IT parks, a major automotive and engineering base and a large student population. Its startups move fast and need content that keeps up.

kolkata.name: Kolkata
kolkata.areas: Park Street, Salt Lake, New Town, Gariahat and Bowbazar
kolkata.intro: Kolkata's buyers are loyal to brands they trust, from sweet shops to jewellers in Bowbazar. Bengali-first storytelling and a calendar built around Durga Puja make the difference here.
kolkata.jewellery_note: Kolkata's jewellery trade is centred on Bowbazar, and Poila Baishakh, Durga Puja and Dhanteras are the key buying moments.

ahmedabad.name: Ahmedabad
ahmedabad.areas: SG Highway, Prahlad Nagar, CG Road, Navrangpura and Manek Chowk
ahmedabad.intro: Ahmedabad is a city of family businesses, textile and pharma manufacturers and fast-growing food brands. Gujarati and English content that respects the family story works well.
seasons: Diwali and the Gujarati New Year (October–November)
ahmedabad.jewellery_note: Ahmedabad's jewellers range from the old market around Manek Chowk to showrooms on CG Road and SG Highway, with Navratri and Dhanteras as peak seasons.

jaipur.name: Jaipur
jaipur.areas: Johari Bazaar, MI Road, C-Scheme, Malviya Nagar and Sitapura
jaipur.intro: Jaipur is one of India's great centres of gemstones, jewellery, block printing and handicrafts, and its makers sell to buyers worldwide. Craft-led films show the skill behind each piece.
jaipur.jewellery_note: Jaipur is a major gemstone cutting and jewellery centre, from Johari Bazaar to export houses, with kundan, polki and coloured stones that need macro filming to do them justice.

chandigarh.name: Chandigarh
chandigarh.areas: Sector 17, Elante, Mohali, Panchkula and Zirakpur
chandigarh.intro: Chandigarh Tricity has a strong market for education and immigration consultants, real estate, clinics and fashion retail. Buyers expect quick answers, so WhatsApp automation pays back fast.

kochi.name: Kochi
kochi.areas: MG Road, Edappally, Kakkanad, Marine Drive and Fort Kochi
kochi.intro: Kochi brands sell to a Kerala audience and to Malayalis worldwide. Gold, tourism, ayurveda and healthcare all depend on trust, which shows up best in Malayalam-first content.
kochi.jewellery_note: Kerala buys more gold per family than almost anywhere in India, and Kochi's showrooms compete hard around Onam, Akshaya Tritiya and wedding season.

indore.name: Indore
indore.areas: Vijay Nagar, Palasia, Sapna Sangeeta Road, Rajwada and Super Corridor
indore.intro: Indore is famous for its food, has a fast-growing startup scene and a big coaching and education market. Hindi-first reels and quick WhatsApp replies match how the city buys.

lucknow.name: Lucknow
lucknow.areas: Hazratganj, Gomti Nagar, Aminabad, Chowk and Aliganj
lucknow.intro: Lucknow's chikankari, kebabs and old-city traders carry real heritage, and its newer businesses in Gomti Nagar compete for a growing middle class. Content that tells the craft story stands out.

surat.name: Surat
surat.areas: Varachha, Mahidharpura, Adajan, Vesu, Ring Road's textile markets and the Surat Diamond Bourse
surat.intro: Surat cuts and polishes a large share of the world's diamonds and is one of India's biggest synthetic-textile markets. Both trades are moving from B2B to brands, and need content that shows the product up close.
surat.jewellery_note: Surat is a global diamond cutting and polishing hub, and its diamond and jewellery houses increasingly sell to retail buyers who need to see the stone on screen.

coimbatore.name: Coimbatore
coimbatore.areas: RS Puram, Gandhipuram, Peelamedu, Avinashi Road and Saibaba Colony
coimbatore.intro: Coimbatore's spinning mills, pump and motor makers and gold jewellery manufacturers sell across India. Many are family firms ready to turn a strong B2B name into a consumer brand.
coimbatore.jewellery_note: Coimbatore has a large gold jewellery manufacturing base supplying retailers across South India, and Akshaya Tritiya and Deepavali drive retail demand.

visakhapatnam.name: Visakhapatnam
visakhapatnam.areas: Dwaraka Nagar, MVP Colony, Siripuram, Gajuwaka and the Beach Road
visakhapatnam.intro: Vizag combines a major port, pharma manufacturing and a growing tourism market. B2B companies here benefit from clear explainer videos and automated enquiry handling.

nagpur.name: Nagpur
nagpur.areas: Dharampeth, Sitabuldi, Sadar, Wardha Road and MIHAN
nagpur.intro: Nagpur sits at the centre of India's road and logistics map and is known for its oranges, education and healthcare. Marathi and Hindi content reaches both the city and its wider region.

bhopal.name: Bhopal
bhopal.areas: MP Nagar, New Market, Arera Colony, Kolar Road and Hoshangabad Road
bhopal.intro: Bhopal's market is led by education, healthcare and real estate, with craft traditions like zari-batua work. Hindi-first content and fast WhatsApp replies match how buyers here decide.

bhubaneswar.name: Bhubaneswar
bhubaneswar.areas: Patia, Saheed Nagar, Jaydev Vihar, Infocity and Old Town
bhubaneswar.intro: Bhubaneswar is a fast-growing education and IT city at the heart of Odisha's temple and handloom trail. Odia-first stories about craft, food and travel get shared widely.

thiruvananthapuram.name: Thiruvananthapuram
thiruvananthapuram.areas: Technopark, Kazhakoottam, Pattom, Kowdiar and East Fort
thiruvananthapuram.intro: Thiruvananthapuram pairs Technopark's IT companies with healthcare, ayurveda and coastal tourism. Malayalam-first content and a calendar around Onam reach the whole state.
